AKHILESH KUMAR

Email: akhilims@gmail.com | Contact: +91-9718278916

Current address: 406, Bhavani Avenue, Borewell Road, Whitefield, Bangalore - 560066

Objective

To contribute as a Data Scientist by leveraging expertise in Agentic AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, and Machine Learning to design intelligent automation systems for negotiation, logistics, materials and business decision-making. Seeking to drive innovation, efficiency, and value creation in cutting-edge AI projects.

Professional Summary

Designation: Data Scientist – Applied Materials (Dec 11, 2023 – Present)

Experienced Data Scientist with 10+ years across industry and education. Strong track record of designing and delivering end-to-end Machine Learning, NLP, Computer Vision and Agentic AI solutions for manufacturing, logistics, and automation. Hands-on experience building LLM-backed tools, prompt engineering frameworks, rule-based association mining systems, RPA-driven automation, and optimization pipelines.

Key highlights:

Agentic AI for process automation in negotiation, logistics, and materials management.

Built LLM-based systems (RAG + prompt-engineering) for knowledge retrieval, summarization and decision-support.

Designed association-rule and heuristic pipelines for BOM/PO discrepancy detection and correction.

Developed predictive models for risk classification and shortage analysis using structured and unstructured data.

Experience deploying models into production environments and building Windows/Cloud applications for users.

Skills

Agentic AI & Generative AI: Intelligent agents for process automation, negotiation, and logistics

Large Language Models (LLMs): Prompt engineering, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), chain-of-thought prompts, LLMOps



Machine Learning: Supervised and unsupervised models, classification, regression, time-series, model evaluation and deployment

Association Rule Mining: LCA, ECLAT, Boltzmann machines, clustering for BOM/PO correction and anomaly detection

Optimization Techniques: Greedy heuristics, genetic algorithms, particle swarm, and constrained optimization for workforce and resource allocation

Computer Vision: Defect detection (wafers & machines), image preprocessing, transfer learning, CNNs, interpretability

RPA & Automation: AutoCAD Template Automation, data extraction from PDFs/Hadoop, Windows app development for user interfaces

Data Engineering & Tools: Python (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow), SQL, MATLAB, Simulink, Tableau

Other: Monte Carlo simulation, Bayesian regression, storytelling, dashboard design, technical training and client-facing workshops

Software Knowledge

Python, MATLAB, Simulink, SQL 

Work Experience

Data Scientist – Applied Materials

Dec 11, 2023– Present

Responsibilities & Achievements:

Developed Agentic AI systems to automate negotiation-style processes, logistics decision flows and materials planning.

Implemented LLM-backed summarization and prompt-engineered assistants to convert manufacturing comments and procurement logs into actionable insights.

Designed and deployed a BOM discrepancy detection pipeline using association-rule mining, Levantine distance, clustering and heuristic correction suggestions.

Built shortage analysis and root-cause summarization workflows that process free-text comments and structured data to reduce manufacturing shortages.

Created defect identification algorithms using generative AI, deep learning, and classical computer vision to detect defects in wafer and equipment images.

Implemented RPA-based AutoCAD template automation: extracted metadata from Hadoop/PDFs, identified drawings and generated consolidated binders with a Windows UI.

Designed lightweight ML models (including hardware-deployable versions) for process control such as discharge coefficient prediction.

Sr. Software Engineer – Tech Mahindra

Jul 27, 2021 – Dec 04, 2023 (2 years 4 months)

Delivered data science solutions for NSR risk classification, workforce allocation optimization and enterprise automation.

Built pipeline for handling imbalanced multimodal data (quantitative, categorical, textual) and improved classification performance using gradient-based methods.

Integrated ML models with enterprise systems and collaborated cross-functionally to deploy production workflows.

Assistant Manager – Application Engineer, DesignTech Systems Pvt. Ltd.

Mar 22, 2016 – Jul 24, 2021 (5 years 4 months)

Assisted government and industry clients (DRDO, NML, IMMT, NERLDC, NPL, IITs, NITs) with IoT, forecasting, data analysis, computer vision, and model-based design solutions.

Delivered custom MATLAB/Python prototypes and provided training, webinars and hands-on workshops for clients.

Guided junior colleagues and performed knowledge transfers; developed application-specific code and demos for client engagements.

Executive – Application Engineer, ADCC Infocad Ltd. (Now Ceinsys Tech Ltd.)

Feb 09, 2015 – Mar 07, 2016 (1 year 1 month)

Key contributions:

Worked on simulation, modeling, optimization and delivered ML/IoT proofs-of-concept for clients.

MATLAB Trainer – DUCAT, Ghaziabad

Aug 17, 2014 – Jan 25, 2015 (6 months)

Conducted hands-on trainings on MATLAB, Simulink, machine learning and data analytics.

Projects & Applications (Selected)



Defect identification using Computer Vision with Machine Learning (Applied Materials) – Designed algorithms to detect defects in wafers and machines using generative AI, deep learning and classical computer vision techniques; integrated model outputs with traceability and operator feedback loops.

Identify Discrepancy in Order BOM – Developed a hybrid model using association rules mining (LCA+ECLAT), Levantine distance, clustering and heuristic methods to identify discrepancies in Order BOM and suggest corrections.

RPA based AutoCAD Template Automation (Applied Materials) – Processed and extracted information from Hadoop and PDFs to identify drawings, bind documents, and delivered a Windows application for users to manage templates and outputs.

Shortage Analysis (Applied Materials) – Processed free-text comments and structured data to identify root causes for shortages and produced informative summaries for manufacturing teams.

Workforce Allocation using Optimization in Python (Applied Materials - TechM) – Automated engineer allocation across multiple sites using greedy heuristics and constraint-based scheduling to minimize costs and travel time.

Risk Classification using Python (Applied Materials - TechM) – Classified NSR risk into high and low categories using techniques suitable for imbalanced, multimodal data; experimented with multiple models and selected best performing gradient-based methods.

Discharge Coefficient Prediction (Applied Materials) – Designed and deployed a lightweight ML predictive model (including hardware deployment) to predict gas flow discharge coefficient for process control.

DC motor control using Arduino and ThingSpeak – Controlled DC motor remotely using Arduino and ThingSpeak as data-aggregator; deployed Simulink model to Arduino Uno and Android interface for control.

Text to speech and speech to text conversion using computer vision and data acquisition – Built two applications: one for visually impaired users to read printed text using a camera and TTS; another voice-controlled assistant for Android similar to Google Assistant/Alexa.

Fall detection and tracking of electronic devices – Used GPS, accelerometer and camera on Android to detect device falls, send pictures and location to a remote server.

Surveillance camera model on Raspberry Pi – Deployed a surveillance model on Raspberry Pi with Android integration over Wi‑Fi for remote monitoring.

IoT based GPS tracker – Live tracking solution for multiple people/devices using MATLAB and ThingSpeak.

Emotion Detection using CNN (Deep Learning) – Implemented CNN-based emotion detection; documented methodology on technical blog.

Deep Learning Model for Detecting COVID-19 on Chest X-ray – Developed deep learning pipeline and published methodology on technical blog.

Forecastive Model for Covid-19 Patients – Forecasting model for confirmed cases and death rate analysis.



Arduino control using Stateflow – Designed controller using Stateflow to control electronics (voltage, speed etc.)

Model-Based Design and MIL to PIL – Worked on model‑based design and transition from MIL to PIL for embedded workflows.

EMI filter design for mobile communication devices (M.Tech Project) – Designed EMI filter and documented methods for CM/DM noise reduction; analysis done on Pspice.

Channel capacity enhancement using MIMO technology (B.Tech Project) – Explored MIMO techniques to improve channel capacity using space multiplexing and signal processing techniques.

Agentic AI, LLM & Prompt Engineering based Projects

Designed multi-agent workflows that combine LLM reasoning, structured optimization and rules engines to automate negotiation steps (e.g., counter-offers, SLA checks) and provide next step to buyers and generate email for suppliers

Logistics & Materials Agent: Built agent pipelines that monitor PO/BOM changes, run discrepancy detection (association rules + heuristics), and recommend rerouting or re-prioritization to minimize shortages and lead-times.

Prompt Engineering & RAG: Created prompt templates & retrieval chains to extract manufacturing knowledge from SOPs, procurement logs and free-text comments. Implemented retrieval-augmented generation to keep responses grounded and auditable.

LLM + Machine Learning (for compliance and hard constraints) with LLMs (for context and interpretation)  for Non-Conformance prediction  and produce actionable recommendations.

LLMOps & Model Governance: Implemented versioning, evaluation and monitoring practices for LLMs and ML models in production, including input validation, human-in-the-loop review, and KPI tracking.

Research Paper: EMI Reduction Techniques for Mobile Communication Devices (ICIECE-2013)

Channel Capacity Enhancement Using MIMO Technology (IEEE / ACCES 2012)

Multiple papers on signal processing and channel capacity (IEEE, IJSTR)

Appreciation letters from DRDO, NML, NPL and other government/academic bodies

Presented at national and international conferences
